name: @storyengine/mode-scene
description: Scene — the built-in narrator mode, as a package that consumes the SDK exactly as a third party would.
dependencyNote: One dependency, and that is the claim docs/design/19-tech-stack.md §10 makes: a built-in mode consumes the published SDK exactly as a third party would. `@storyengine/shared` is reachable through the SDK's re-export and is deliberately not listed — two paths to one vocabulary is how the second one stops being the contract.
